title: Nik's Craftables - Mob Heads
description: Adds recipes for mob heads. Unlock the recipe by killing the respective mob.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds crafting recipes for mob heads. The recipies are obtained by killing the respective mob. Good for builders who need mob heads for decor or for PVPers who want to show off their kills. Includes every vanilla head, including the player head.

![7 crafting tables in a 2x3 pattern with the 7th centered in front, with items placed on top in each block of the crafting table. Floating above those items are mob heads for a piglin, ender dragon, wither skeleton, player head, creeper, zombie, and skeleton. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c18daece64413abcc5ccdcf26be1243e55d4a350_0.webp)
